description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit program spending records with the mission and grant-purpose records they answer to: the mission record with its reference, the mission statement, period, the programs and grant purposes it names and the method it states for allocating administrative costs to programs; each program with its id, reference, name, the status the records report (active, inactive or closed), the program spending total it states and the currency; each expense with its id, the program, amount, whether it is direct or an allocated administrative cost, any allocation method named and the moment; each activity with its id, the program, the moment and what was done; each outcome figure with its id, reference, the program, what it measures and the figure stated; each underlying count with its id, the outcome and the count. The signed report gives the mission and the programs, each program total recomputed from its direct and allocated expense records, each allocated administrative cost against a stated method, each program reported as active against the spending and activity recorded in the period, and each outcome figure against the underlying counts, and counts them, and names divergent program spending records: a program total that does not recompute from the expense records, administrative costs allocated to programs with no stated method, a program reported as active with no spending or activity recorded in the period, and an outcome figure the underlying counts do not support; then a program the mission and grant-purpose records do not name and an expense or activity naming a program the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No programs, no expense records, or an outcome figure with no underlying count leaves those points unverified. Programs and records match by letters and digits, amounts add to the cent, and a program is named in the mission records when a stated purpose carries every word of its name, or its name every word of the purpose, plurals folded. This reads whether the program spending and outcomes the organization records hold together with the purposes it states. Verdict nonprofit_program_divergent, nonprofit_program_partial, nonprofit_program_unverified or nonprofit_program_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-program-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
